violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. NO CFM PRESENT AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: PICKLED RADISH.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS DISCUSSED WITH CFM THAT HOUSE MADE PICKLED RADISH, WHICH IS KEPT FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS, MUST BE DATE MARKED AND USED WITHIN 7 DAYS (INCLUDING DATE OF PREPARATION). CFM LABELLED MAIN CONTAINER OF PICKLED RADISH.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: Observed no hot water available at hand sink next to mop sink. Maximum water temperature observed at 39F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F. EHS recommended CFM contact licensed plumber to repair/adjust faucet so that hot water of at least 100F is available. EHS will follow up on or around 10 days.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed no paper towels at the hand sink next to the mop sink and the hand sink next to the 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CFM moved paper towel roll to hand sink next to mop sink.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed no hand soap available at the hand sink next to the mop sink and hand sink next to 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed bowl of chicken in preparation step stored underneath 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. CFM instructed employee to move bowl of chicken to food prep table. EHS reminded CFM and employee that no food should be stored on the floor.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed ceiling tiles, air vents, walls throughout kitchen with accumulation of dust and debris.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. CFM will clean ceiling tiles, air vents, and walls of kitchen.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: container of raw chicken on top shelf of #2 over RTE food.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM moved chicken to bottom shelf. CFM advised employees to keep raw chicken on bottom shelf.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage Prohibited in Toilet Rooms
violations.observation: Observed bag of corn starch in employee restroom.
violations.corrective_action: CFM removed food from employee restroom.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating, smoking, or drinking in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection. -Employee observed consuming lunch in the kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. Employee moved to dining area to continue to eat lunch.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers for spices were observed reused for the storage of other spices, ex: sesame seeds stored in plastic manufacturer container for Cajun seasoning.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. Discussed container usage with PIC.
